newsitem.title: CANADA: Carlin Resources revises private placement.
newsitem.headline: Carlin Resources revises private placement.

text.p: Carlin Resources Corp said due to market conditions, its previously announced private placement agreement to raise up to C$2.5 million by issuing special warrants had been revised.

Under the terms of the revised offering, Carlin said it would now issue up to 4.2 million special warrants at C$0.60 per warrant. The company was not immediately available to comment on the previous warrant terms.

Each warrant could be exchanged for one unit comprised of one common share and one-half of a share purchase warrant, it said. Each full-share purchase warrant would entitle the holder to buy one additional common share for a period of two years at a price of C$0.60 for the first year and C$0.80 after that, the company said.
Funds would be used for exploration on Carlin's existing properties in Ghana and Burkina Faso as well as other properties in Africa, and for working capital, it said.
